title: LocalParquetNemotronSource — DuckDB-backed source over data/personas/nemotron-korea/data/train-*.parquet
acceptance: Implements PersonaSource: search(query) → PersonaSearchResult, sample(config) → PersonaRecord[], getById(id) → PersonaRecord | null

search() supports every PersonaSearchQuery field: textQuery (substring), source (provider/dataset filter), locale (country/language/province/district), demographics (ageMin/ageMax + array filters), uxTraits (range tuples), sampleSize, diversityBy
sample() distributes across age × region × occupation buckets when diversityBy is set
getById() decodes a `nemotron:<dataset>:<rowId>` id back to a single row
Each result row passes through NemotronNormalizer before being returned

Tests: when the dataset cache exists, the checkout demo's persona query returns >=3 rows aged 40-65; the crack 19-19 query returns >=3 rows; queries with no matches return an empty array (not throw); the test suite skips gracefully if data/personas/nemotron-korea is absent so the gate stays green offline
